IDT12420.name: Derwent Estuary
IDT12420.text:
Monday 2 November
Winds: North to northwesterly below 10 knots becoming east to southeasterly in the middle of the day then tending south to southeasterly 10 to 15 knots in the early afternoon.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Tuesday 3 November
Winds: South to southwesterly about 10 knots tending south to southeasterly 10 to 15 knots in the middle of the day then shifting westerly below 10 knots in the late evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Wednesday 4 November
Winds: North to northwesterly below 10 knots tending southwesterly 10 to 15 knots during the afternoon then tending westerly during the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 80% chance of showers.

Thursday 5 November
Winds: Westerly 10 to 15 knots turning northwesterly during the afternoon.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.
IDT12420.synoptic: A low pressure system is forecast to move across Victoria and cross the Bass Strait today, before moving over the Tasman Sea tomorrow. A cold front is expected to move across Tasmania from the west on Wednesday followed by a more significant cold front later Friday.

IDT12326.name: South East Coast
IDT12326.text:
Monday 2 November
Winds: West to northwesterly 10 to 15 knots, reaching up to 20 knots offshore during the morning. Winds becoming variable about 10 knots in the middle of the day.
Seas: 1 to 1.5 metres, decreasing below 1 metre around midday.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 to 3 metres inshore, increasing to 2.5 to 4 metres offshore.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Tuesday 3 November
Winds: Variable about 10 knots.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 to 3 metres.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Wednesday 4 November
Winds: Northerly about 10 knots tending northwesterly 10 to 15 knots during the morning then turning west to southwesterly 15 to 25 knots during the day.
Seas: Around 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres during the evening.
Swell: Southwesterly 1.5 to 2.5 metres.
Swell: Northeasterly around 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 90% chance of showers, with possible small hail in the afternoon and evening.
